title: The Finch Circle Birthday Note — Member Terms
content:
**Rule.** On the first day of the member's birth month (the month of the date of birth on the customer profile) a birthday Finch Note of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, issued for the reason "birthday", of the tier's birthday note value is issued, valid for the tier's birthday note validity days counting the issue date as day 1, for the tier held on that day.

**Membership age.** The membership has existed for at least the minimum membership days, in calendar days, before the first day of the birth month; this is read from the enrolled date on the membership record.

**Limits.** A tier whose birthday note value is not applicable receives no birthday note; one birthday note is issued per calendar year; a missed birthday note (membership suspended on that day) is not issued later; the member's date of birth cannot be changed to move the birthday note.

The birthday note value, validity and minimum membership days of each tier are those of the birthday reward schedule.

## Cases (hypothetical; birth month June, minimum 30 days)

| Enrolled date | Calendar days before 1 June | Birthday note |
|---|---|---|
| 2 May | 30 | issued |
| 3 May | 29 | not issued this year |

- A Finch Circle Platinum member with a June birthday receives on 1 June a note of that tier's value, its validity counted with 1 June as day 1.
- A member whose membership is suspended on 1 June receives no birthday note for that year, and it is not issued after reinstatement.
- A Finch Circle Member tier membership receives no birthday note.
